rationale: The buyer is very clear — dev teams at startups and SMBs with Claude API in production — and the pain (revenue-impacting downtime from 529 overload errors) is real and they already pay for API access, indicating genuine willingness to pay for reliability tooling. The fatal constraint is buildability and autonomy: a production-grade multi-provider LLM proxy with circuit-breaker logic, reliable failover, latency management, and the trust required for teams to route API keys through it is a serious infrastructure product, not a Claude-prompt-plus-Stripe-link. It is not shippable by a solo non-technical operator in a week, and maintaining it requires ongoing DevOps vigilance — this is squarely in engineer/infra territory. Several well-funded competitors (LiteLLM, Portkey, OpenRouter) already occupy this space.
solution_plan: Realistically, a solo non-technical operator could NOT build and maintain a production LLM proxy service — this requires server infrastructure, API key security, latency SLAs, and ongoing incident response that go well beyond Claude prompts and a landing page. A narrower adjacent angle that IS buildable: a 'Claude API Health Monitor' — a simple status dashboard and email/SMS alert service that watches the Anthropic status page and known error patterns and immediately notifies subscribers when degradation is detected, giving teams a heads-up to switch manually. Factory builds this as a Claude-driven monitoring script + a simple landing page + Stripe ($9/mo) + SendGrid alerts. Outreach to Claude API developers via HN, Twitter/X dev communities, and the Anthropic Discord — batches approved by Youval. Delivery and billing are automated; the only human step is approving outreach. However even this narrower version competes with free status-page tools, so validate the $9/mo price point with 10 DMs before building.
notes: buildability_with_ai scored 3 and operational_autonomy scored 4 for the full proxy concept — both fail build gates (mins of 6 and 7 respectively). The narrower monitoring/alert angle is more buildable but has lower defensibility and WTP. Stage capped at validate pending both broader corroboration of the pain and a scoped solution that a solo operator can actually ship.
